problem: Operator-preservation v0.3 protects spaced alphanumeric operands and compact numeric operands, but compact symbolic-variable forms such as x*y, x^y, x÷y, x−y and x%y can still lose their operator during replay canonicalization and collapse toward the same material identity as xy. This can create false replay suppression and erase a genuine contested branch.
risk: fake certainty from collapsed symbolic evidence
requiredBoundary: Do not solve this by preserving every compact slash or hyphen. ASCII slash remains ambiguous with paths such as a/b, and ASCII hyphen remains ambiguous with lexical compounds. Promotion must be bounded to compact variable forms with a restricted operator set while retaining path/non-arithmetic negative controls.
